WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) as player_count
  FROM player_college
  GROUP BY college_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(player_count) as all_college_avg,
    SUM(player_count) as total_players
  FROM college_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT cc.player_count, s.all_college_avg, s.total_players
  FROM college_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE cc.player_count > s.all_college_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(player_count) as avg_player_count,
  AVG(1.0 * player_count / total_players) as avg_fraction_of_total,
  AVG(player_count - all_college_avg) as avg_excess
FROM above_average
